title: BINOM.DIST.RANGE with s < s2 evaluates the stored CDF difference rather than summing masses
statement: When number_s < number_s2 and 0 < probability_s < 1, BINOM.DIST.RANGE(trials, probability_s, number_s, [number_s2]) truncates trials, number_s, and number_s2 and evaluates RN53(RN64(BINOM.DIST(s2, n, p, TRUE) - BINOM.DIST(s - 1, n, p, TRUE))) (or the upper tail directly when s = 0) rather than summing individual probability masses, with subnormal results flushed to 0. All 1,224 full-bank BINOM.DIST.RANGE rows match.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (dc96l3_discrete rows 207-210, 232) and Excel 16.0 build 20430 (1,224/1,224 full-bank matches; CDF difference held 383/421 live rows against 20/421 for a mass sum).
inferred: That Excel routes every interior s < s2 range through the two-CDF subtraction beyond the sampled grids is inferred.
